title: Product first-pass orientation beacon — lightweight tour & checklist UI kit
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Design and deliver a compact, modular "orientation beacon" UI kit for first-time Console users. This ticket covers hero visuals, checklist variants, empty-state illustrations, microcopy for tips and tooltips, and a small set of annotated product screenshots to be used in the first-run tour and Quickstart sidebar. The beacon should be unobtrusive, performance-friendly, and easy to adapt across hosted/dedicated/private flows. Scope excludes onboarding backend orchestration and A/B rollout config (handled in ENG).
assets_required: Empty state illustrations (3 variants: no-projects, no-models, no-usage)
Annotated product screenshots (6) with callouts for primary actions
Design tokens: color/spacing/typography mapping to console theme
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens exported to Figma library and documented
Production-ready SVGs + 1x/2x raster PNGs available in Drive
Checklist component handoff with states and interaction notes
Empty-state art reviewed and signed off by PM & engineering
Copy for tips validated against accessibility reading level (AA)
comments: 2026-03-10 Sofia Patel: Initial scoping — sketched three layout directions: corner beacon, center modal stripe, and inline sidebar card. Recommend corner beacon for minimal disruption to key tasks. Added asset checklist.

2026-03-11 Ethan Wang: UX review — agreed on corner beacon. Raised concern about discoverability for first-time users who skip welcome walkthroughs. Proposal: persistent small badge in header that expands into checklist on click.

2026-03-12 PM Morgan Lee: Product feedback — prioritize no-projects and no-models empty states; both map to clear first actions (create project, import model). Ask: include CTA variants (primary/secondary) and SEO-friendly alt text for illustrations.

2026-03-12 Design Review: Ran a 30-minute critique with Design Ops. Decisions: use muted gradient background for beacon, 8px corner radius, avoid heavy shadows to keep visual weight low. Use brand accent color for progress indicator only.

2026-03-13 Engineering sync (Jacob Tran): Confirmed handoff format (SVG + JSON token mapping). Raised a fallback requirement for disabled JS — beacon should degrade to a static inline checklist. ENG will add a small API to mark checklist items complete.
2026-03-14 Sofia Patel: Uploaded final illustration set to Drive and updated Figma file with component variants. Seeking PM sign-off on copy and eng estimate before moving to handoff.
2026-03-14 Morgan Lee: PM sign-off provided on copy. JIRA ticket ENG-22411 opened for checklist persistence and analytics events. Follow-up: design to produce motion spec and export tokens.
notes: Trade-offs considered: a full-screen walkthrough would increase discoverability but harms time-to-first-task and increases implementation scope. Chosen solution trades a bit of discoverability for lower engineering lift and better long-term maintainability. Accessibility: beacon will support keyboard focus and ARIA labels. Performance: assets optimized as SVG + compressed PNGs; prefer CSS animations over JS where possible.
follow_up_tasks: DES-51730 — motion spec polish and Lottie exploration (if needed)
ENG-22411 — backend: checklist persistence + analytics events
PM-4198 — decide on rollout % and experiment metrics
